Shamanicca is a content creation brand — rooted in ancient wisdom, expressed through modern media. We produce original content, design intentional apparel, and create sacred objects for those who walk a conscious path.

What Shamanicca Is

Shamanicca is not a blog. It is a multimedia content brand — a living creative ecosystem built around content, community, and conscious expression. At its core, Shamanicca produces original content exploring the transformative realms of Mindfulness, Wicca, White Magic, Alchemy, and Shamanism, bridging ancient spiritual traditions with the modern human experience.

The brand operates across three interconnected dimensions:

  • 🎬 YouTube — Main Content Channel
    The primary home of Shamanicca’s video content. Original productions exploring spirituality, symbolism, and conscious living. Watch on YouTube →
  • ✍️ Blog — Editorial Content
    In-depth written explorations of spiritual traditions, practices, tools, and philosophy — for seekers who go deep.
  • 🛍️ Store — Intentional Products
    Apparel and sacred objects designed to carry meaning — each piece a wearable expression of the brand’s symbolism and values.

What We Explore

Shamanicca’s content is organized around six pillars, each illuminating a different dimension of the mystical journey:

  • Ancient Wisdom & Cultural Roots — The history and evolution of spiritual traditions across cultures and centuries.
  • The Wheel of the Year & Seasonal Celebrations — Sacred festivals, seasonal rituals, and reconnecting with nature’s cycles.
  • Magical Tools & Ritual Practices — Wands, athames, herbs, and sacred symbols — the instruments that anchor and amplify practice.
  • Symbols, Divination & Esoteric Arts — Tarot, numerology, astrology, and runes — the languages of the unseen.
  • Mindfulness, Healing & Self-Discovery — Meditation, shadow work, and holistic well-being for the modern seeker.
  • Energy Healing & Spirit Guides — Working with unseen forces, energy healing, and forming relationships with spirit guides and totem animals.

The Creator Behind Shamanicca

Shamanicca was created by Mauricio Bayuelo Vanegas — known creatively as Anormal — a multidisciplinary content creator, artist, and digital entrepreneur.

Mauricio’s work spans digital design, music, communication, programming, numerology, psychology, sacred geometry, copywriting, and illustration. His creative output is deeply rooted in shamanic tradition — not as an aesthetic, but as a lived framework for understanding reality.

As a content creator, Mauricio uses Shamanicca as a platform to document, explore, and share the intersection of ancient spiritual knowledge and the modern human experience — across video, written word, and physical product. His work is oriented toward raising awareness of a more just, intentional, and sustainable way of living.

Shamanicca is not a hobby. It is an ongoing creative project with a clear mission: make ancient wisdom accessible, wearable, and relevant for the people who need it today.

Follow the Journey

Shamanicca is built in public — across video, editorial, and social. Join the community wherever you spend time.

  • 🎬 YouTube — @shamanicca (main content)
  • 📸 Instagram — @shamaniccatv
  • 🎵 TikTok — @shamaniccatv
  • 📧 contact@shamanicca.com
